Major Attaway is an American actor for the English-language dub of .

==Biography==
Attaway became a voice actor as an adult. Attaway first worked on Pokémon animation voicing several Pokémon during Secrets of the Jungle before joining , voicing Murdock of the Rising Volt Tacklers.
